Private mapping counting how many sales each address has performed.

Total token supply.
Token name string.
Token symbol string.
Private owner address controlling privileged functions.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view gate that whitelists owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale and otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transferFrom performing unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic and calling ensure().
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale restriction logic using _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale/_onSaleNum.

Owner-only batch send with unchecked arithmetic on total and balances in a loop.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.

Payable constructor setting name, symbol, supply, owner=msg.sender and allowances.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and transfer initiation.

edges.reason: Parameter _to flows into transfer().
Parameter _value flows into transfer().
Parameter _from flows into transferFrom().
Parameter _value flows into transferFrom() balance arithmetic.
Parameter _spender flows into approve().
Parameter _value flows into approve().
Parameter _from flows into ensure() whitelist checks.
Parameter _value flows into ensure()/condition().
Parameter _from indexes _onSaleNum in condition().
Parameter _value is compared with _minSale/_maxSale in condition().
Parameter a is the delegatecall target address in delegate().
Parameter b is the raw calldata forwarded via delegatecall.
Parameter spender is used as balanceOf key in _mints().
addedValue is scaled by 10**decimals without checks in _mints().
saleNum is written into _saleNum in init().
token is scaled into _minSale in init().
maxToken is scaled into _maxSale in init().
_tos array is iterated in batchSend().
_value multiplied by _tos.length without overflow check in batchSend().
addr is written into tradeAddress in setTradeAddress().
local total is deducted from balanceOf[msg.sender] unchecked in batchSend().
loop local _to is credited in batchSend() without arithmetic guards.
loop counter i drives the batchSend for-loop.
msg.sender is forwarded as _from into transferFrom() from transfer().
msg.sender controls the allowance branch and is credited/debited in transferFrom().
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve().
msg.sender must equal owner to reach the delegatecall in delegate().
msg.sender is compared to owner/hardcoded address in _mints().
msg.sender must equal owner in init().
msg.sender must equal owner and its balance is modified in batchSend().
msg.sender must equal owner in setTradeAddress().
msg.sender becomes owner and receives totalSupply in the constructor.
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom().
transferFrom() calls ensure() to gate the transfer.
ensure() calls condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() calls pairFor() to recompute the pair address.
delegate() executes the delegatecall operation on attacker calldata.
delegatecall transfers control to an arbitrary external address that can execute arbitrary code in this contract context.
transferFrom() performs unchecked balance/allowance subtractions and additions.
batchSend() performs unchecked multiplication and balance updates.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() mutates balanceOf without SafeMath.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] to block further sales.
ensure() reads the canSale whitelist.
ensure() compares _from/_to with owner.
ensure() compares _from with tradeAddress.
condition() reads _minSale.
condition() reads _maxSale.
condition() reads _saleNum.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from].
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*(10**decimals).
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true.
_mints() uses decimals for scaling.
init() writes _minSale.
init() writes _maxSale.
init() writes _saleNum.
init() scales limits by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
batchSend() updates balanceOf entries with unchecked arithmetic.
setTradeAddress() writes the whitelisted tradeAddress.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
constructor assigns totalSupply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor grants infinite allowance to the UNI router address.
constructor computes totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals).
constructor uses decimals for supply scaling.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transient recipient argument consumed only by transfer().
_value is a transient amount argument consumed only by transfer().
_from is consumed only by transferFrom() balance/allowance logic.
_value directly drives the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic of transferFrom().
_spender is a transient key written into allowance by approve().
_value is stored into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_from is the whitelist lookup key inside ensure().
_value is forwarded by ensure() into condition().
_from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition().
_value is bounded by _minSale/_maxSale inside condition().
a is the target of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
b is the raw calldata executed by the unsafe delegatecall.
spender is the balanceOf/canSale key written by _mints().
addedValue is scaled into the minted balance in _mints().
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init().
token is scaled into _minSale by init().
maxToken is scaled into _maxSale by init().
_tos is iterated to credit recipients in batchSend().
_value multiplies _tos.length in the unchecked arithmetic of batchSend().
addr is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
local total is the unchecked product subtracted from the caller balance.
loop local _to is the recipient credited in each iteration.
loop counter i only controls the batchSend iteration.
